name: Beast of Virtue
description: A rare Magical specimen of an animal that possesses the remarkable powers attributed to it by medieval bestiaries.

name: Black Dog of the Moor
description: A magical hound with tracking powers who frees mistreated hounds and is hunted by a local noble in a story seed.

name: Caladrius
description: A kind-hearted magical bird prized by kings and magi for its healing powers.

name: Cockerel of Virtue
description: A magic cockerel whose crowing keeps invisible demons away from a village.

name: Great Stallion of the Camargue
description: A magical stallion who knows the Camargue better than any other living creature and flees humans with his herd.

name: Pentele
description: A being who protects the Beasts of Virtue inhabiting a magical garden realm and may allow visitors to hunt there in exchange for favors.

name: Panther of Virtue
description: A magical panther whose lure causes mysterious disappearances of animals and can ensnare incautious investigators.

name: Raven of Virtue
description: A magical raven that delivers omens of bad things to come.

name: Salamander of Virtue
description: A small poisonous magical salamander that seeks warmth, extinguishing fires, and can pass through a weak Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Stag of Virtue
description: A magical stag whose antlers have healing powers; it has the Ways of the Forest Virtue and is a difficult quarry.

name: White Stag of the Wood
description: A magical white stag who guards a forest and its deer, attacking grogs who poach there.

name: Wise Owl of the Forest
description: A talkative magical owl who monitors the forest, questions its animals, and shares information about magical creatures, vis sources and regiones.

name: Ants of Virtue
description: Dog-sized ants of Ethiopia that dig up gold and guard it fiercely.

name: Antelope of Virtue
description: A very wild beast with saw-like horns that can cut down trees.

name: Ape of Virtue
description: A magical ape that loves to imitate men; apes in Europe are found only in Iberia near Gibraltar.

name: Asp of Virtue
description: A venomous serpent of several types, easily charmed by music, said to guard a balm-bearing tree or bear a carbuncle gem.

name: Beaver of Virtue
description: A gentle magical beaver whose testicles have medicinal properties and whose teeth can cut down trees.

name: Bees of Virtue
description: Magical bees spontaneously generated from rotting cattle carcasses, forming a model society ruled by a king.

name: Crow of Virtue
description: A magical crow said to know the paths of treachery and predict the future.

name: Dog of Virtue
description: A magical dog that may heal wounds by licking them; its body parts are useful in warding.

name: Dolphin of Virtue
description: The fastest fish in the ocean, friendly to man, fond of music, and a harbinger of storms.

name: Eagle of Virtue
description: A magical eagle with wondrous eyesight that rejuvenates itself by flying to the sun and diving into a fountain.

name: Echeneis of Virtue
description: A small fish that attaches itself to ships and slows them to a standstill.

name: Elephant of Virtue
description: A wise magical elephant that lives three hundred years and never forgets; it must eat mandrake root to mate.

name: Fox of Virtue
description: A trickster fox that feigns death to lure carrion birds.

name: Goat of Virtue
description: The best climber among beasts, with eyesight keen enough to tell hunters from travelers at a distance.

name: Goose of Virtue
description: A good watchman that can smell humans better than any other animal.

name: Hare of Virtue
description: A swift, timid hare that can change sex; Alpine hares turn white by eating snow.

name: Hercinia of Virtue
description: A bird of the forests of southern Germany whose glowing feathers light travelers' paths.

name: Hoopoe of Virtue
description: A foul bird nesting near cemeteries whose blood and heart are powerful ingredients in black magic.

name: Kingfisher of Virtue
description: The halcyon, whose mid-winter nesting calms the sea for two weeks.

name: Lynx of Virtue
description: A keen-sighted lynx whose urine hardens into the flame-colored stone lyncuriam.

name: Mouse of Virtue
description: A mouse born spontaneously from the soil, able to gnaw iron.

name: Owl of Virtue
description: A magical owl that can captivate other birds and charm its captors into releasing it.

name: Pelican of Virtue
description: A bird that revives its dead offspring by shedding its own blood over them.

name: Weasel of Virtue
description: An unclean animal with an understanding of medicine; the only animal able to kill a basilisk.

name: Whale of Virtue
description: A giant whale whose back becomes covered with sand and plants, so sailors mistake it for an island.

name: Wolf of Virtue
description: A rapacious wolf whose gaze paralyzes its prey.

name: Woodpecker of Virtue
description: A bird that makes nails and wedges fall out of any tree it perches on.

name: Lion of Virtue
description: A magical lion ruler to whom the king of the Bees of Virtue owes tribute in a story seed.

name: Basilisk
description: The mightiest of serpents, with a Might of about 30; only the weasel can kill one.

name: White Wolves of House Tremere
description: Wolves associated with House Tremere, similar to Wolves of Virtue but with Intelligence rather than Cunning.

name: Physiologus
description: An anonymous first-century Greek manuscript on which most medieval bestiaries are based.

name: Bestiary
description: A medieval book about the characteristics and behavior of beasts, attributing remarkable powers to animals.

name: Pierre de Beauvais
description: A bestiary author cited on the Antelope and the Asp.

name: Pliny the Elder
description: Ancient author cited on Alpine hares and on mice.

name: Aristophanes
description: Greek playwright whose play The Birds describes the founding of Nephelococcygia.

name: The Birds
description: Play by Aristophanes, a tractatus of Quality 5 in Magic Lore, describing Nephelococcygia as intercepting communications between earth and heaven.

name: The Saga of the Volsungs
description: Norse saga quoted describing a worm creeping to its watering place.

name: Lyncuriam
description: A semi-precious flame-colored stone formed from the hardened urine of the Lynx of Virtue.

name: Carbuncle
description: A gem said by some bestiaries to lie on the asp's forehead.

name: Aetites
description: A magical stone some eagles build into their nests.

name: Mandrake
description: A Plant of Virtue whose root elephants must eat before they can mate.

name: Cage of Change
description: An iron enchanted cage (CrVi 30) that gives a captive animal 5 Warping Points in hope it becomes monstrous and can be harvested for Muto vis.

name: Nephelococcygia
description: A mobile magic regio (aura 10) in the clouds inhabited by intelligent birds, containing a city of nine concentric walls; its entrance usually lies in the Thebes Tribunal.

name: Bird of Nephelococcygia
description: Intelligent birds inhabiting Nephelococcygia, not Beasts of Virtue, playable as magical characters with song-based powers.

name: Tereus
description: King of the birds of Nephelococcygia, an epops who nests atop a thousand-foot spire said to hold records of prayers.

name: Trochilus
description: The scatter-brained small brown wren who keeps the single gate of the city of Nephelococcygia.

name: Philomena
description: A swallow, sister-in-law of Tereus, who claimed in an interview recorded at Durenmar that Tereus' spire holds records of prayers.

name: Assembly of Birds
description: A mid-winter gathering that all Birds of Nephelococcygia must attend, at which new songs are performed and criticized.

name: Command the Flock
description: Power (ReAn 35) letting the bird trill commands to up to 100 birds for a duration of Sun.

name: The Crow's Song
description: Power (PeCo 40) that forces an Aging Roll with +5 on a target the next time he sleeps.

name: Air for Flying
description: Power (ReAu 35) keeping local weather calm while the bird sings, negating weak magical weather.

name: Call the Flock
description: Power (ReAn 35) summoning a cloud of mundane birds to gather around the singer.

name: Magical Lineages of Cats
description: Three families of cats tracing descent to the familiars of the Founders or their earliest apprentices, each with its own oral history and culture.

name: Black Lineage
description: Aristocratic cat lineage descended from Founder Jerbiton's familiar, centered at Valnastium, whose cats defend the home and walk wards around settlements.

name: White Lineage
description: Friendly cat lineage descended from Founder Mercere's familiar, found in his House's covenants, protectors of people.

name: Tortoiseshell Lineage
description: Cat lineage associated with Celtic spellcasters, split after the Schism War with kings in Scotland and the Rhineland, known for predicting the future.

name: Jerbiton
description: Founder whose familiar, a prince of Egyptian cats, began the Black Lineage.

name: Mercere
description: Founder whose familiar began the White Lineage of cats.

name: Founders
description: The founders of the Order of Hermes, whose familiars began the magical lineages of cats.

name: Valnastium
description: The domus magna of House Jerbiton in the Tribunal of the Greater Alps, center of the Black Lineage of cats.

name: Bubastis
description: Ancient Egyptian city whose great queens were ancestors of the Black Lineage's founding cat.

name: Tribunal of the Greater Alps
description: Tribunal in which Valnastium lies.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the entrance to Nephelococcygia is usually located.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the Bonisagus magus Yonnlius is a Master.

name: Schism War
description: Conflict after which the Tortoiseshell Lineage of cats split into two groups.

name: House Diedne
description: House to which the Tortoiseshell Lineage of cats may have had links.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House served by the Black Cats, whose domus magna is Valnastium.

name: House Mercere
description: House of Founder Mercere, in whose covenants the White Lineage is found.

name: House Tremere
description: House known for its white wolves.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House of the magus Yonnlius.

name: House Flambeau
description: House of the hoplite whose Ignem magic warped a family of mice.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House whose magi often consider the cage of change abhorrent.

name: House Merinita
description: House whose magi often consider the cage of change abhorrent.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: Cat power (Mentem) that overcomes the shock of talking cats and inclines humans to obey.

name: Blackberry Cat
description: Cat power, also called Feigned Innocence, making a group forget something the cat did.

name: Curse of Rheumatism
description: Cat power giving rheumatism in the limb of anyone who touches (kicks) the cat.

name: Drain Energy
description: Cat power similar to Invocation of Weariness at Touch or Eye range.

name: Fear of the Mouse
description: Cat power similar to Panic of the Trembling Heart, making people afraid of the cat.

name: Feline Lullaby
aliases: Keeping the Humans Safely Tucked Away
description: Cat power, also Keeping the Humans Safely Tucked Away, a version of The Call to Slumber.

name: Humans are Easily Misplaced
description: Cat power, a version of Inexorable Search using scent-marked Arcane Connections.

name: Incredibly Cute
description: Cat power similar to Trust of Childlike Faith that impairs others' rationality.

name: Mackerel Sky
description: Cat power, a version of Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow.

name: Master of the Undergrowth
description: Cat power, a version of Intuition of the Forest.

name: Minor Allergy
description: Cat power, a Sight-range version of Touch of the Goose Feather.

name: Moving Objects with the Mind
description: Cat power, a Sight-range version of Unseen Arm.

name: Prison for Mice and Birds
description: Cat power, a version of Circle of Beast Warding.

name: Prying Eyes
description: Cat power (Imaginem) letting a cat touching a roof see inside the room.

name: Suck the Breath
description: Cat power causing an asthma attack like Grip of the Choking Hand.

name: Suckle Cows Dry
description: Cat power making a cow lactate while cats suckle.

name: Suffocate the Dead
description: Cat power similar to Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit, used by sleeping on a ghost's grave.

name: Viper's Gaze (cat power)
description: Cat power, a variant of Viper's Gaze used to immobilize prey.

name: Wake the Dead
description: Cat power animating corpses by leaping over them, like Awaken the Slumbering Corpse.

name: Warder's Walk
description: Vim power used by Black Lineage cats to combine powers, a variant of Wizard's Communion.

name: Whispers Through the Black Gate
description: Cat power to talk to corpses, most often found in tortoiseshells.

name: Cat Like a Shadow
description: Personal cat power, a version of Veil of Invisibility.

name: Felianthrope
description: Personal cat power to take human shape, a version of The Beast Remade.

name: Inconspicuousness
description: Personal cat power, a version of Invisibility of the Standing Wizard.

name: Puffed Up and Hissing
description: Personal cat power granting extra mass, a version of Beast of Outlandish Size.

name: Resistance to Claws
description: Personal cat power making its coat resistant, a version of Doublet of Impenetrable Silk.

name: True Sight of the Air (cat power)
description: Personal cat power, a version of the spell True Sight of the Air.

name: Unmarked Passage
description: Cat power, a version of Trackless Step.

name: Black Cat Wards
description: Group of protective powers used by Black Cats to defend homes or settlements from minor faeries and demons.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant ward that keeps out magical creatures such as the Raven or Fox of Virtue unless they penetrate it.

name: Loss of But a Moment's Memory
description: Spell whose effect Blackberry Cat mimics.

name: Invocation of Weariness
description: Corpus spell similar to Drain Energy.

name: Panic of the Trembling Heart
description: Mentem spell similar to Fear of the Mouse.

name: The Call to Slumber
description: Mentem spell of which Feline Lullaby is a version.

name: Inexorable Search
description: Spell of which Humans are Easily Misplaced is a version.

name: Trust of Childlike Faith
description: Mentem spell similar to Incredibly Cute.

name: Sailor's Foretaste of the Morrow
description: Auram spell of which Mackerel Sky is a version.

name: Intuition of the Forest
description: Herbam spell of which Master of the Undergrowth is a version.

name: Touch of the Goose Feather
description: Corpus spell of which Minor Allergy is a Sight-range version.

name: Unseen Arm
description: Terram spell of which Moving Objects with the Mind is a version.

name: Pass the Unyielding Portal
description: Herbam spell also used as a cat power to open doors.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: Animal ward spell of which Prison for Mice and Birds is a version.

name: Grip of the Choking Hand
description: Corpus spell whose effect Suck the Breath duplicates.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
description: Mentem spell against ghosts, mimicked by Suffocate the Dead.

name: Viper's Gaze
description: Animal spell used by cats to immobilize prey.

name: Awaken the Slumbering Corpse
description: Corpus spell animating a corpse, similar to Wake the Dead.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: Vim spell combining the power of casters; Warder's Walk is a variant.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Imaginem spell of which Cat Like a Shadow is a personal version.

name: The Beast Remade
description: Animal spell of which Felianthrope is a personal version.

name: Invisibility of the Standing Wizard
description: Imaginem spell of which Inconspicuousness is a personal version.

name: Beast of Outlandish Size
description: Animal spell of which Puffed Up and Hissing is a personal version.

name: Doublet of Impenetrable Silk
description: Animal spell of which Resistance to Claws is a personal version.

name: True Sight of the Air
description: Auram spell granting true sight, also a cat power.

name: Trackless Step
description: Terram spell of which Unmarked Passage is a version.

name: Circular Ward Against Demons
description: Vim ward simulated by Black Cat Wards.

name: Ward Against Beasts of Legend
description: Animal ward simulated by Black Cat Wards.

name: Ward Against the Faeries of the Wood
description: Herbam ward simulated by Black Cat Wards.

name: Ring of Warding Against Spirits
description: Mentem ward simulated by Black Cat Wards.

name: Lungs of the Fish
description: Aquam spell, a continuously active power of Arkliss.

name: Peering Into the Mortal Mind
description: Mentem spell, whose Sight-range power version Polymathes possesses.

name: The Enigma's Gift
description: Spell whose effect the cage of change resembles, causing rapid Warping.

name: Dragon
description: The largest and most fearsome mortal creatures, intelligent, with four legs and bat-like wings, renowned for cunning and lust for treasure.

name: Serpent
description: The least of the dragons' kin, snake-like supernatural creatures often venomous and able to entrance.

name: Drake
description: Misshapen, less intelligent caricatures of dragons with legs and often stunted wings and dangerous breath.

name: Worm
description: Huge serpent-like dragon-kin, typically venomous, that crush or suffocate victims in their coils.

name: Stellatus
description: A dragon from ArM5, small for a dragon at Size +8.

name: Jörmungandr
description: The Midgard Serpent, with a Might of 75.

name: Scitalis
description: A slow-moving six-foot serpent with spectacular colors that stupefy those who look at it; its venom causes wounds.

name: Varkos
description: A misshapen fire drake living in a mountain cave who desperately wants to be seen as a fearsome dragon.

name: Arkliss
aliases: Arkliss, a Dragon of the Fens
description: A small but fierce true dragon lairing in a bog, able to dominate people with her gaze and breathe pestilence.

name: Polymathes
description: An ancient, magically potent dragon who hoards rare books and scrolls in a tunnel lair of illusions.

name: Lindwurm
description: A huge legless bat-winged worm of German and Scandinavian tales that hoards treasure and takes hostages for ransom.

name: Dazzling Appearance
description: Scitalis power (ReMe) stupefying all who look at it.

name: Puff of Flame
description: Varkos' power to spit a ball of flame.

name: Torrent of Flame
description: Varkos' power to belch a 30-pace torrent of flame.

name: Domination
description: Arkliss' gaze power to bend a person to one command.

name: Pestilential Breath
description: Arkliss' power exhaling a disease-causing mist.

name: Master of Illusion
description: Polymathes' Focus Power to alter appearances as Muto Imaginem.

name: Fiery Breath
description: Polymathes' power belching fire 50 paces long.

name: Poisonous Blood
description: Polymathes' deadly blood that stays potent for nine days.

name: Poisonous Breath
description: Lindwurm power exhaling a cloud of poisonous black smoke.

name: Venomous Bite
description: Lindwurm bite with the same toxic effect as its breath.

name: Constriction
description: Optional grapple-based attack by which dragons and worms suffocate victims.

name: Transformed Animal
description: An animal Warped by magic whose magical qualities relate to the transforming event; it gains no Magic Might.

name: Warping
description: Accumulated mystical effect that grants animals Flaws and eventually Virtues as their Warping Score rises.

name: Wizard's Twilight
description: State a Hermetic magus may enter if caught in a penetrating cage of change.

name: Cat-Fish
description: A Warped cat, fore-part black cat and back-part silvery fish, living in a tributary of the Seine.

name: Dog that Flew
description: A Warped hunting dog with grey feathered wings, able to glide, hiding near Hersfeld.

name: Mice That Burned the Barn
description: A family of mice Warped by Flambeau Ignem magic that belch sparks and set barns alight.

name: Yonnlius
description: Bonisagus magus, a Master in the Rhine Tribunal, who caught and studied the cat-fish.

name: Hersfeld
description: Town in Central Germany with a bell tower over which a flying dog was seen in 1217.

name: Benedictine Abbey of Hersfeld
description: Abbey near Hersfeld whose monks recorded the flying dog as a miracle.

name: Seine
description: River in Champagne said to contain a powerful magical regio that Warped the cat-fish.

name: Champagne
description: Region whose fishermen tell stories of the cat-fish.

name: Durenmar
description: Place where records such as Philomena's interview and the cat-fish study are held; home of the Great Library.

name: Great Library of Durenmar
description: Library that it would be inadvisable to mention to Polymathes.

name: Camargue
description: Region home to the Great Stallion of the Camargue.

name: Ethiopia
description: Land said to be home to the Ants of Virtue.

name: Straits of Gibraltar
description: Area in Iberia where apes are found in Europe.

name: Iberia
description: Only part of Europe where apes are found.

name: Alps
description: Mountains whose hares turn white eating snow and over which Nephelococcygia sometimes wanders.

name: Rome
description: City alerted by geese to an attack by the Gauls.

name: Scotland
description: Seat of one king of the Tortoiseshell Lineage of cats.

name: Rhineland
description: Seat of one king of the Tortoiseshell Lineage of cats.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica.

name: Qualities
description: Traits purchased by magical creatures (including Minor Virtues); cats may have only 10 points of them.

name: Inferiorities
description: Negative traits of magical creatures, counterparts to Qualities.

name: Athletics
description: Ability; flying is represented as its specialty.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability used for taming, training and commanding animals.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability used to predict Nephelococcygia's path and command tamed elementals.

name: Ride
description: Ability that may substitute for Animal Handling when using a mount.

name: Brawl
description: Ability important for dragon combat and constriction attacks.

name: Penetration
description: Ability boosting powers against Magic Resistance.

name: Leadership
description: Ability normally determining how many can be led in a trained group.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used to spot creatures.

name: Regio

name: Aura

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link to a target required for some powers; cats scent-mark humans to create them.

name: Familiar
description: A magus' bonded animal; the cat lineages descend from the Founders' familiars.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that powers must penetrate to affect a target.

name: Confidence Score
description: Score representing a character's confidence; default 1 (3) for magical beings.

name: Aging Roll
description: Roll made for aging, forced by The Crow's Song.

name: Lab Text
description: Laboratory record produced while taming a creature, usable as a guide for later taming.

name: Taming
description: Seasonal activity accumulating points against a creature's Might to tame it.

name: Loyalty Test
description: Roll of Loyal Personality Trait plus stress die against an Ease Factor for commanding tamed creatures.

name: Trained Group
description: Group of tamed animals led in combat using Animal Handling.

name: Study Requirement
description: A requirement for magical study that collecting Alpine hares might fulfill.

name: Domus Magna
description: The central covenant of a House, such as Valnastium for Jerbiton.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural talent whose social penalties apply to taming; magical creatures are often unaffected.

name: Season (character)
description: Life-stage classification of magical characters (Spring, Summer, Winter) affecting experience.

name: Experimentation
description: Rules a magus may use when taming an animal.

name: Warping Score
description: Score from accumulated Warping points that grants animals Flaws and Virtues.

name: Grog
description: Covenant servant or warrior character type.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator who brings transgressions before the Tribunal.

name: Redcaps
description: Hermetic messengers who demand the covenant deal with a Wolf of Virtue.

name: Hoplite
description: A Flambeau combat magus whose Ignem magic warped mice.

name: Magic Humans
description: Humans or human-form beings affected by the realm of Magic: giants, Spirit Votaries, Magic Kin, and the transformed.

name: Giants
description: Magic humans far larger than normal humans.

name: Spirit Votaries
description: Humans who have accepted a link with, and power from, spirits.

name: Magic Kin
description: Lineages of near-human creatures with a consistent touch of the Magic realm.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi.

name: Magic Realm
description: The Realm of Magic to which Magic Might creatures are native.

name: Divine
description: Realm that is not now mediated by Nephelococcygia.

name: Faerie
description: Realm whose influence can also cause Warping.

name: Infernal
description: Realm; some cats may be Infernally tainted and Infernal wolves may take over a forest.
